1643eba833: The simplest definition of resonance is "an object sounding because it vibrates in sympathy". A guitar's strings without the body sound faint and thin. The voice is the same: the raw sound of the vocal folds lacks beauty of tone and needs the sympathetic vibration of the body's spaces to become a ringing, sustained singing voice. When you sing, all three resonances are present at once; you just adjust the balance to suit the song and phrase.

38d1d764c7: **Yawn and sigh**: pretend to yawn, and at the widest moment sigh gently on "ha". Remember the open space at the back of your mouth; it's the basis of mouth resonance.
3e77049328: **Humming**: close your mouth with teeth slightly apart and hum the five-note scale 1 2 3 4 5 4 3 2 1 on /m/, rising a semitone each round. Pay special attention to whether the bridge of your nose tingles.
2210672628: **Palm on the chest**: three notes below your speaking pitch, say /hei/. When your palm feels the vibration, that's chest resonance.
48b1e78cb5: **Nose-pinch test**: pinch your nose while singing a long /a/. If the sound gets clearly muffled, air is going through the nose and making it nasal; if it hardly changes, your resonance is in the right place.
7f84ee49df: **Siren slides**: slide slowly on /u/ or /ng/ from your lowest note to your highest and back. Where the sound suddenly breaks and the tone changes is your register break; find which note it is on a keyboard and write it down.
3fea6d64c6: The high range uses more head resonance and the low range leans on the chest. Without the polish of head resonance the voice sounds dry and hard; without the support of the chest it sounds thin and floaty. Mixing the three comes down to the register break: going from chest to head, bring the volume down a little and keep the mouth open so the two sounds hand over gradually, instead of pushing harder to force your way up.
6e8df2fcf3: Resonance is an advanced topic in singing, and beginners find it hard to tell for themselves whether they're using the right spaces. Comparing recordings and getting instant feedback from the teacher are the most reliable ways to avoid going down the wrong path.
